modify.note: Make phone-only booking an option for personal events as well as team and organization events. Expose the phone-versus-email requirement control through the booking-field editor.
Carry the phone-versus-email requirement choice into the booker form.

Carry the phone-versus-email requirement choice into server-side validation. Reuse the existing phone-only attendee representation and phone validation so a booking with a valid required phone number can be confirmed without asking the attendee for an email address. Keep the email-confirmation path working for event types that select it.

Update SMSManager's send path so a phone-only attendee is eligible for notifications even when the calendar event has no team ID. The base implementation returns early for personal events and for teams outside an organization; remove those eligibility restrictions while preserving the organization's explicit `disablePhoneOnlySMSNotifications` preference where applicable. Continue using the existing SMS rate-limit check, sender selection and message templates. Send through this path only when the attendee has a phone number and is represented as a phone-only booking; ordinary email attendees should retain their current notification behavior. Apply the same eligibility decision to both single-attendee and all-attendee sends.

add_edges.label: dispatches SMS via sendSmsOrFallbackEmail
add_edges.note: Continue using the existing `sendSmsOrFallbackEmail` dispatcher. Carry the organizer and optional team context through dispatch so personal bookings have a usable rate-limit identity without a fabricated team ID.
